verdict.rationale: The only evidence of bulk triage is a community report that, when deleting, you can trash or mark done all messages from the same sender in one action. That is a real one-stroke bulk action by the product itself, but it is scoped by sender rather than by arbitrary multi-selection. Auto Archive and the Cmd+K command palette are adjacent features, not multi-select bulk actions, so they earn no credit. missing for 10: documented arbitrary multi-select of conversations, bulk archive across a selection, bulk labeling, first-party documentation of bulk actions, independent hands-on corroboration.
